ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case Record Type is Direct Debit or Direct Entry or NPP and not in the Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute'), OR( NOT(Queue__c = 'Support Coach Queue'), NOT(Queue__c = 'Digital Fraud Queue'), ISNULL(Queue__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue.
